concept: S3 encryption: client-side — AWS never sees plaintext or keys
tests: Client-side vs server-side encryption when AWS must have access to neither the data nor the keys.
expected: Client-side encryption (AWS Encryption SDK) with customer-controlled keys — only ciphertext reaches S3. Triggers: "encrypt before sending", "AWS never has access to plaintext or the keys".
why_not: SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS are server-side: AWS encrypts and has access to the keys; Block Public Access is about exposure, not encryption.
